cobblemon.ability.bizarre.desc: After this Pokémon has been on the field for 1 turn, the effectiveness of each type swaps. This effect ends when the Pokémon leaves the field.
cobblemon.ability.viciousjaw.desc: Biting attacks from this Pokémon lower the targets Defense and Sp. Defense stats.
cobblemon.ability.sirenssong.desc: All sound based moves are converted to Water-type and doom the target to faint in 3 turns.
cobblemon.ability.heartofdiamond.desc: Boosts to this Pokémons Defense stat will instead boost its Attack stat.
cobblemon.ability.spectralretribution.de: When this Pokémon is knocked out, it performs the last move it used before fainting.
cobblemon.ability.windupcannon.desc: This Pokémons attacks always go last and deal half damage, but hit 3 times.
cobblemon.ability.chillingglare.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it horrifies opposing Pokémon, lowering their Sp. Attack stat.
cobblemon.ability.cursedsoil.desc: This Pokémon heals 1/3rd of its max HP when another Pokémon faints.
cobblemon.ability.dullingpaper.desc: After this Pokémon attacks, its Attack and Speed stats are lowered.
cobblemon.ability.ignite.desc: Normal-type moves become Fire-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
